id: 01_How to Maintain Sterility with Aseptic Technique Cell Culture Basics Training
title: 细胞培养基础：用无菌操作保持无菌
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/01_How to Maintain Sterility with Aseptic Technique Cell Culture Basics Training.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/01_How to Maintain Sterility with Aseptic Technique Cell Culture Basics Training/src.py

points.K1: 无菌操作决定培养成败
points.K6: 七成乙醇，用前用后都清洁
points.K9: 定位摆放，双手直进直出
points.K12: 只用无菌物接触无菌物

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台生物安全柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet with its front glass half open and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲细胞培养的无菌操作。
overlay: 细胞培养基础：用无菌操作保持无菌

shots.scene: 细胞培养瓶、喷壶、移液管三个图标，外圈一道防护圈挡住细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a culture flask, a spray bottle and a wrapped pipette, inside a protective ring that keeps tiny germ icons out. No people.
shots.narration: 无菌操作，就是不让微生物进来。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着短裤和凉鞋，端着培养瓶急匆匆走向安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in shorts and sandals hurries toward a biological safety cabinet carrying a culture flask.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次养细胞，急着开工。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手臂在敞开的瓶口上方横扫过去，瓶口冒出小细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sweeps his arm over an open flask inside the cabinet; tiny cartoon germ icons drift toward the flask opening.
shots.narration: 手从开口瓶上方一扫，细菌就进去了。

shots.scene: 几天后，培养瓶里的液体变浑浊，阿杰皱眉
shots.prompt_en: A few days later the young male student frowns at a culture flask whose liquid has turned cloudy.
shots.narration: 几天后，培养液浑了，细胞全废了。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白操作规程走过来，指指阿杰的凉鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a blank procedure sheet and points at the young male student's sandals.
shots.narration: 小研说：从穿戴到收尾，一步都不能省。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 无菌操作，靠的是每个细节。

shots.section_title: 无菌操作决定培养成败
shots.scene: 欣欣指着一只清澈的培养瓶和一只浑浊的培养瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at two culture flasks: one with clear pink liquid and one with cloudy liquid.
shots.narration: 养好细胞，关键是挡住微生物。
overlay: 无菌操作决定培养成败

shots.section_title: 无菌操作决定培养成败
shots.scene: 空气、手、台面、瓶口四个箭头指向培养瓶，旁边有小细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: Four arrows from the air, a hand, a bench surface and a bottle neck point toward a culture flask, each with a tiny germ icon. No people.
shots.narration: 污染可能来自空气、手和器具。

shots.section_title: 无菌操作决定培养成败
shots.scene: 小研在安全柜前慢慢操作，动作平稳
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works slowly and steadily inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 懂无菌环境，动作慢而稳，

shots.section_title: 无菌操作决定培养成败
shots.scene: 小研对照一份空白规程逐条打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks items one by one on a blank checklist beside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 每一条操作规范都照着做。

shots.scene: 小研穿上实验服，系好扣子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a long-sleeved lab coat and fastens it in a changing area.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先穿戴个人防护。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a lab coat, safety goggles and a pair of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服、护目镜、手套是基本配置。

shots.scene: 王老师向阿杰讲解一张空白的防护要求表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank protective equipment chart to the young male student.
shots.narration: 需要哪些防护，问本单位安全团队。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前翻看一份空白的说明书，旁边放着试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet on a computer screen, with a reagent bottle beside her.
shots.narration: 用培养基和试剂前，先查安全说明书。

shots.scene: 说明书图标旁出现危险象形图和防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon with a hazard pictogram and a goggles icon next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 看清危害、防护和应急措施。

shots.scene: 阿杰把凉鞋换成包脚的运动鞋，短裤换成长裤
shots.prompt_en: The young male student changes his sandals for closed-toe sneakers and his shorts for long trousers.
shots.narration: 鞋要把脚包住，衣服要遮住双腿。

shots.scene: 凉鞋、短裤图标被红叉划掉，旁边是打勾的包脚鞋和长裤
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sandals and shorts crossed out with a red X, next to ticked icons of closed-toe shoes and long trousers. No people.
shots.narration: 凉鞋短裤，不能进实验室。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽前用洗手液认真洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands carefully with liquid soap at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 接触细胞前，先把手洗干净。

shots.scene: 放大镜下手背上的细菌和皮屑图标被水冲走
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the back of a hand shows tiny germ and skin flake icons being rinsed away by water. No people.
shots.narration: 洗掉细菌，也洗掉脱落的皮屑。

shots.scene: 一片皮屑图标飘向培养瓶，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tiny skin flake icon drifting toward a culture flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 皮屑落进培养瓶，也会带来污染。

shots.section_title: 七成乙醇，用前用后都清洁
shots.scene: 一只空白标签的喷壶，旁边是酒精图标
shots.prompt_en: A spray bottle with a blank label next to an alcohol droplet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 七成乙醇能杀灭多数污染微生物。
overlay: 七成乙醇，用前用后都清洁

shots.section_title: 七成乙醇，用前用后都清洁
shots.scene: 小研戴手套用纸巾擦拭安全柜台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves wipes the work surface of the biological safety cabinet with a paper towel.
shots.narration: 清洁是无菌操作最要紧的一环。

shots.section_title: 七成乙醇，用前用后都清洁
shots.scene: 开工和收工两个时钟图标，中间都有擦拭图标
shots.prompt_en: Two clock icons labeled by sun position, morning and evening, each with a wiping hand icon beneath. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜用前擦一遍，用后再擦一遍。

shots.scene: 喷壶对着酒精灯火焰喷洒的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spray bottle spraying toward a small burner flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有明火的地方，绝不能喷酒精。

shots.scene: 欣欣捂住嘴，旁边一团火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot covers its mouth in alarm next to a flame icon.
shots.narration: 酒精雾一遇火，就会着起来。

shots.scene: 培养基瓶外表面放大，上面有灰尘颗粒图标
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the outside of a medium bottle with tiny dust particle icons on its surface. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶子外面沾着灰尘和微生物。

shots.scene: 小研给瓶子喷乙醇，用纸巾擦干净
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays a bottle with alcohol and wipes it with a paper towel.
shots.narration: 放进柜里的每样东西，都要擦拭。

shots.scene: 小研把擦好的试管架放进柜内
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a wiped tube rack inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 可以放进前喷，也可以放进后马上喷。

shots.section_title: 定位摆放，双手直进直出
shots.scene: 柜内台面上物品在固定位置排好，地面有虚线定位框
shots.prompt_en: Items stand in fixed positions on the cabinet work surface, each inside a dashed outline. No people.
shots.narration: 擦好的物品，放到固定位置。
overlay: 定位摆放，双手直进直出

shots.section_title: 定位摆放，双手直进直出
shots.scene: 小研双手笔直向前伸进柜内
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reaches straight forward into the cabinet with both hands.
shots.narration: 双手直进直出，

shots.section_title: 定位摆放，双手直进直出
shots.scene: 手臂在柜口左右横扫，气流箭头被打乱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arm sweeping sideways across the cabinet opening with scattered airflow arrows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要在柜口横扫，会打乱气流。

shots.scene: 台面堆满瓶瓶罐罐，气流箭头被挡住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet work surface crowded with bottles and racks blocking airflow arrows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 台面不要堆满东西。

shots.scene: 手肘碰到瓶口的图标，旁边小细菌
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an elbow bumping into a bottle neck with a tiny germ icon. No people.
shots.narration: 太挤容易碰到，增加污染机会，

shots.scene: 整洁的台面上气流箭头顺畅向下
shots.prompt_en: A tidy cabinet work surface with smooth downward airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 还会挡住气流，护不住无菌区。

shots.scene: 安全柜前窗玻璃停在较低位置，箭头指示
shots.prompt_en: The front glass sash of a biological safety cabinet sits at a low working position, with an arrow pointing to it. No people.
shots.narration: 工作时，前窗放在规定的低位。

shots.scene: 前窗推得太高，气流箭头外逸，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cabinet sash raised too high with airflow arrows escaping outward, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 推得太高，气流就保不住了。

shots.section_title: 只用无菌物接触无菌物
shots.scene: 欣欣举着无菌包装的移液管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pipette in a sealed sterile wrapper.
shots.narration: 核心原则：只用无菌的东西碰它们。
overlay: 只用无菌物接触无菌物

shots.section_title: 只用无菌物接触无菌物
shots.scene: 无菌培养基、试剂、耗材三个图标，都带勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green ticks: a medium bottle, a reagent vial and a wrapped pipette. No people.
shots.narration: 培养基、试剂和耗材，都要无菌的。

shots.scene: 俯视柜内布局：左侧管架，中后部试剂瓶，右侧移液器
shots.prompt_en: Top view of the cabinet layout: tube racks on the left, reagent bottles at the center back, a pipette controller on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器放右手边，试剂放中间靠后。

shots.scene: 小研右手持移液器，左手开瓶，动作顺畅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the pipette controller in her right hand and opens a bottle with her left hand.
shots.narration: 这样取用顺手，

shots.scene: 手臂从开口瓶上方跨过的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arm crossing over open bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手和东西都不从无菌物品上方跨过。

shots.scene: 小研在柜内撕开移液管包装，管尖不碰任何东西
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet the female graduate student peels open a pipette wrapper; the pipette tip touches nothing.
shots.narration: 拆移液管，管子不碰非无菌的东西。

shots.scene: 手握移液管上端，插入移液器
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand grasps the top end of a pipette and inserts it into a pipette controller.
shots.narration: 握住管子上端，插进移液器。

shots.scene: 小研把刻度转向自己，把包装丢进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the pipette's markings toward herself and drops the wrapper into a waste bin.
shots.narration: 刻度转向自己，再丢掉包装。

shots.scene: 移液管尖碰到柜壁，随即被丢进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A pipette tip touches the cabinet wall by accident and is immediately dropped into a waste bin.
shots.narration: 不小心碰脏了，直接扔掉换新的。

shots.scene: 培养基瓶只在柜内打开，柜外开瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle opened inside the cabinet with a green tick, next to a bottle opened outside the cabinet crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 培养基和试剂，只在柜里打开。

shots.scene: 小研用小指勾住瓶盖，手指不碰盖子内缘
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a bottle cap with her little finger, keeping her fingers away from the inner rim.
shots.narration: 拿瓶盖，手不碰盖子里面的边缘。

shots.scene: 瓶盖开口朝下放在台面上，旁边是打勾
shots.prompt_en: A bottle cap placed upside down with its opening facing down on the work surface, next to a green tick. No people.
shots.narration: 要放下时，盖口朝下放。

shots.scene: 小研取完液立刻把盖子拧回去
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student screws the cap back on right after drawing liquid.
shots.narration: 用完尽快盖回去。

shots.scene: 移液管尖碰到瓶子外壁的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pipette tip touching the outside of a bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 移液时，管尖别碰瓶子外壁。

shots.scene: 小研稳稳地把液体加入培养基瓶，管尖悬空
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steadily dispenses liquid into a medium bottle with the pipette tip held clear of the rim.
shots.narration: 也别碰任何非无菌的地方。

shots.scene: 一支移液管用完被丢进废物桶，旁边标着“1”
shots.prompt_en: A used pipette is dropped into a waste bin, with a large number one icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一支移液管，只用一次。

shots.scene: 同一支移液管伸进第二个瓶子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the same pipette dipping into a second bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要拿同一支，再伸进另一个瓶子。

shots.scene: 移液管插在瓶里留着用的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pipette left standing inside an open bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不要把它插在瓶里留着用。

shots.scene: 小研双手轻轻摇匀培养基瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently swirls a medium bottle with both hands.
shots.narration: 加完添加剂，轻轻摇匀。

shots.scene: 小研在瓶身空白标签上画勾和日期图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student marks a blank label on the bottle with a pen, drawing a tick and a small calendar icon.
shots.narration: 在瓶上做好标记，是好习惯。

shots.scene: 小研用大号移液管转移液体
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student transfers liquid between two bottles with a large pipette.
shots.narration: 大量转移液体，首选无菌移液管。

shots.scene: 瓶子倾斜，液体从瓶口前角导流倒入另一瓶的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a bottle tilted with liquid flowing from its front corner into another bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 熟练后也可无菌倾倒，快而果断。

shots.scene: 台面上一小滩液体，小研立刻用沾乙醇的纸巾擦掉
shots.prompt_en: A small spill on the cabinet surface is wiped up immediately by the female graduate student with an alcohol-soaked paper towel.
shots.narration: 洒出来的液体，立刻用乙醇擦净。

shots.scene: 小研给敞口培养瓶换液，手从侧面伸入
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student changes the medium in an open culture flask, reaching in from the side.
shots.narration: 传代、换液，原则都一样。

shots.scene: 只在柜内开盖、不跨敞口瓶两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two ticked icons: a cap opened inside the cabinet, and an arm passing beside an open flask rather than over it. No people.
shots.narration: 只在柜内开盖，不从敞口瓶上方跨。

shots.scene: 小研不急不躁，动作连贯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a steady, unhurried pace with smooth movements.
shots.narration: 不慌不忙，动作干脆利落。

shots.scene: 被碰过的移液管和瓶子图标放进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a touched pipette and a touched bottle going into a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 不重复用移液管，

shots.scene: 阿杰想捡回一支碰过的移液管，小研摇头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches for a pipette that touched the bench; the female graduate student shakes her head.
shots.narration: 被碰脏的东西，宁可扔掉也不用。

shots.scene: 小研把柜内每个瓶子的盖子拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tightens the cap of every bottle inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 做完后，所有瓶子先拧紧再拿出。

shots.scene: 在柜外被打开的瓶子图标，标着打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle opened outside the cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 在柜外开过的，不能再用来养细胞。

shots.scene: 小研用乙醇再擦一遍台面，把物品归位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the work surface again with alcohol and puts everything back in order.
shots.narration: 再用乙醇擦台面，整理好再离开。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在安全柜旁，身后排着几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the cabinet with a row of icons behind it.
shots.narration: 最后，我们把要点串一遍。

shots.scene: 防护、洗手、擦拭、布局四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: protective gear, hand washing, wiping, and a tidy layout. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴好、洗净手、擦干净、摆整齐；

shots.scene: 只在柜内开、一次性移液管、不跨越三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bottle opened inside the cabinet, a single-use pipette, and an arm going around an open flask. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内开瓶、移液管只用一次、不跨越；

shots.scene: 盖紧的瓶子、擦拭台面两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: bottles with tightened caps and a hand wiping a work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 收尾盖紧瓶子，擦净台面再离开。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿戴整齐，在安全柜前从容操作，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, properly dressed, works calmly at the cabinet while the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 阿杰这回养的细胞，清清亮亮。

shots.scene: 欣欣在安全柜旁挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 慢而稳、守规范，下课再见！
